rule_or_requirement: Before using privileged TRAIN actions as labels, a teacher must preserve matched valid completion and shorten finished laps on a separate TRAIN block.
observable_information: Frozen geometry and speed teacher outputs plus paired control and teacher finish, lap, progress, collision and latency evidence.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Run the unchanged train-only teacher and selected pixel control on newly assigned TRAIN seeds 5004–5007; no teacher or checkpoint change.
expected_success_endpoint: Teacher completion count is at least control, no candidate-only nonfinish or invalid actions, and jointly completed paired-lap median improves at least 3%.
control: Unchanged StableRiskEnvelopeAgent over selected full-road-guard checkpoint SHA-256 3ceb5ebbe2a4bd96944649a693b8ef924c0252fa620b0fd547c7fb494afff199.
falsifier: Teacher-only nonfinish, fewer finishes, invalid action, or less than 3% median paired-lap improvement on the new twelve TRAIN cells.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Twelve paired TRAIN cells on tracks 1–3 × seeds 5004–5007, twenty-four episodes total.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered 1,800-second Linux CPU diagnostic, 2,000 decisions per episode; no fresh tune, held-out, confirmation, blind or official action.
